Game Overview

Temple Battle Lightsaber is a action game built around engage in thrilling lightsaber duels within a mystical temple, navigating rising poisonous waters and dodging falling TNT. With strategic timing against a friend, choose your team wisely and outlast your rival in this intense survival showdown. Only the most cunning will escape the temple's deadly embrace victorious.
